articles.title: American embassies tighten security as Iran threat warnings intensify ahead of U.S. midterm elections
articles.description: A memo from DNI director Jay Clayton said Iran is in the "advanced stages" of planning attacks against Americans.

articles.title: After SpaceX restores high-speed service, Musk claims Ukraine violated Starlink agreement

articles.title: Democrats, voting-rights groups challenge Trump's bid to block Alaska Senate certification
articles.description: Lawsuits filed by candidate Mary Peltola and a voters' rights group challenge Trump's preemptive efforts to block a Democratic Senate victory in Alaska.

articles.title: Google Quietly Updates Privacy Policy to Let Gmail and Photos Data Feed Ads

articles.title: AI funding fears rattle Wall Street. Here's how we're adjusting our portfolio

articles.title: Sweden's Government Offices Block ChatGPT and Claude, Keep Microsoft Copilot

articles.title: Fewer people are flying as airfare soars. Here's why airlines aren't worried

articles.title: Block's new voice AI sounds eerily human, sparking awe and scam fears

articles.title: Why McDonalds, Microsoft and Google saying no to tokenized stocks isn't a dealbreaker

articles.title: I quit my marketing job to walk dogs for 4 months: It's 'one of the most valuable professional experiences I've ever had'

articles.title: Bitcoin’s wealthy holders turning to loans and yield as investment habits mature: Xapo CEO
